card.name: Footnote symbols like double dagger
card.fires_on: Rare footnote marker symbols such as the double dagger (‡) or broken bytes of it, placed after a drug name, number, or sentence in a table.

modes.label: Marker after drug name
modes.description: A double dagger directly follows a drug name in an interaction list.

modes.label: Broken marker bytes
modes.description: A piece of an unreadable footnote symbol appears after a dose or sentence, before the footnote text.

card.plain: It marks the odd footnote symbols that tag table entries in drug labels.
